name: bee-agent-harness
description: PRODUCT §3.1 agent scenario harness: runs every AS-* scenario with fresh Claude Code and Codex agents against a bee server and checks goal states through API assertions only. Usage: `bun run harness --help`. Validate scenarios: `bun run harness --dry-run --scenarios all`. Self-tests: `bun test`. Full run: `BEE_HARNESS_ADMIN_TOKEN=<token> bun run harness --server http://127.0.0.1:7420 --runtimes claude-code,codex --runs 3 --scenarios all`.
